item.title: Israeli, 26, dies during trek in Nepal after gas exposure in shower
item.description: A young Israeli collapsed while showering during the Annapurna trek in Nepal and died following exposure to gas. The Chabad House issued a warning to travelers in the area.

item.title: Rolex in tefillin bag: Kfar Saba mayor questioned over suspected obstruction
item.description: The mayor of Kfar Saba sent a relative to fetch his tefillin bag from his office. An inspection revealed watches inside, including a Rolex.

item.title: Five days after soldier found dead, family demands autopsy before burial
item.description: Combat engineer Osher Avraham, 19, of Rehovot, was found dead in his room at a northern base on Friday.

item.title: Denmark's oldest person revealed to have held Nazi leadership role
item.description: Kirsten Schwalbe, 112, reportedly served in leadership positions within Denmark's Nazi Party during World War II, despite previously claiming she had little interest in politics.

item.title: Watch: Officers open car trunk and discover two illegal residents hidden inside
item.description: Acting on intelligence, Jerusalem-area Border Police stopped a suspicious car at the a-Za'ayyem crossing and found two illegal residents from Jenin hidden in its trunk. The driver, an Ashkelon resident in his 20s, was arrested along with them.

item.title: Anwar Sadat's son: 'My father died for peace, and peace is still possible'
item.description: Gamal Sadat recalls his father's historic decision to make peace with Israel, the personal price he paid, and his enduring belief that courageous leaders can bring reconciliation to the Middle East.

item.title: Police disconnect, seize loudspeakers at Tel Sheva mosque following noise complaints
item.description: Following repeated complaints about excessive noise from a mosque in Tel Sheva, police disconnected the loudspeakers and confiscated the amplification equipment.

item.title: Eisenkot bloc's choice for state comptroller
item.description: The Eisenkot bloc's parties have nominated retired Supreme Court Justice Yosef Elron for state comptroller after the High Court voided the previous election and its winner, coalition nominee Michael Rabilo, withdrew his candidacy.

item.title: Rothman confident: 'Rush to repeal laws signals elections'
item.description: MK Rothman pledges a determined fight against opposition moves to repeal the judicial reform, saying the committees pursuing the repeal are part of a campaign for the next election.

item.description: A confrontation broke out between Joint List MK Hassan al-Nasasra and a police officer after the lawmaker said he saw officers beating and humiliating a handcuffed detainee by the roadside.

item.title: Chicago man charged with hate crime after attacking Jew, shouting 'Free Palestine'
item.description: A 37-year-old suspect allegedly punched a Jewish man wearing a kippah after questioning him about his religion and Zionism. The suspect was already facing charges in two separate assault cases.

item.description: Archaeological excavations at the former Nazi concentration camp uncover ash, bone fragments, and the foundations of SS guard dog kennels, shedding new light on the camp's operations.

item.title: Muslim, Zionist and unapologetic
item.description: Muslim Zionist advocate Sara Zoabi criticizes Arab MKs who left the plenum during "Hatikvah". Speaking to Arutz Sheva, she explains why she proudly sings the anthem and reveals the steep personal cost of her views, even among those close to her.

item.description: Haredi factions are planning to block off the major traffic artery after a man was arrested while dropping off relatives at the airport.

item.title: Draft dodger jailed 10 days before his wedding
item.description: A haredi deserter from Rishon Lezion was arrested at his home overnight. His detention sentence extends beyond his wedding date, scheduled for less than two weeks from now.

item.title: Iran's enriched uranium raises alarm as Western powers demand inspections
item.description: US, UK, France, and Germany demand Iran restore IAEA access, warning that its enriched uranium stockpile remains unverified amid nuclear concerns.
